name: Avid Spellbook Reader (Mythic)
body:
You can retain whole magical tomes in your memory.

Prerequisite: Avid Spellbook Reader.

Benefit: Your bonus on Spellcraft checks from Avid Spellbook Reader doubles, and you can forfeit the requisites for gaining the boons from your preparation rituals known. You can gain the boons for one more ritual at the same time by expending one use of mythic power.
